popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus names the nymph Orseis as Hellen's wife and mother of Dorus, Xuthus, and Aeolus — the maternal stem of the Dorian, Ionian/Achaean, and Aeolian lines.

popCulture.title: Orseis
popCulture.description: Thessalian naiad consort of Hellen — mythical ancestress of the primary Greek tribes through her three sons.

popCulture.title: Hellen
popCulture.description: Son of Deucalion and Pyrrha, husband of Orseis — eponym of the Hellenes whose children divide the Greek ethne.

popCulture.title: Aeolus (son of Hellen)
popCulture.description: Orseis' son by Hellen — eponym of the Aeolians, brother of Dorus and Xuthus in the standard stemma.
